evidence_test: grep -rn -i 'prompt_too_large' spec/  # one line, 29b:61, which names prompt_too_large among the rejections the Founder can correct and counts it in the reject memory; no page under spec/ states the limit, its unit, what is counted (the diff alone, or the diff with the seed pages and the protocol text) or where a session can read either number. Observed: head 6820381 (base bb80d93) rejected rival_unresolved, ref prompt_too_large, detail absent; result.json's rival holds prompt_sha256 and reasons [prompt_too_large] but no size and no limit. What a session can measure is the diff by its own git (python3 tests/push_size.py --base <base> --head <head>, founder records left out as 29e says): 875761 bytes for that head (820062 of them one file, tests/mutant-rows.jsonl), against 456483 bytes for 63811d2..dab6f8b, which was accepted; the limit is somewhere between, and a push between the two cannot be known in advance: a rejection that counts toward not_learning is the only way to find the number. Proposed text (29b, 'Rakip çağrısı'): 'İstek metni (protokol, tohum sayfaları ve diff) bootstrap.json rival.prompt_max_bytes baytını aşarsa rakip çağrılmaz: neden rival_unresolved, ref prompt_too_large. Sonucun rival alanı her koşuda prompt_bytes ve prompt_max_bytes alanlarını, bu rette ayrıca diff bölümü en büyük beş yolu (rival.largest_paths: [{path, bytes}]) taşır.' With the two numbers in every result a session measures its distance from the limit before a push instead of after a rejection. Own side, done in the same push: the record whose rewrite made the diff large no longer changes on main (it is kept on branch kayit/mutant-rows), and tests/push_size.py places a push's diff against the measured sizes.
